text:
Alex Henderson: Heads-up — we need a multi-account, per-AZ quota bump for Dedicated GPU pools. Targets: us-west-2 + us-east-1 across three AWS accounts (prod, staging, analytics). Reason: customer canary + Q3 forecasted growth. Can we agree on numbers before I open cloud support tickets?

Riya Patel: Need current committed capacity and recent peak burst numbers. Also subnet/ENI/EIP limits that tripped last test.

Jordan Li: Current committed (Dedicated) = prod: 48 GPUs, staging: 8, analytics: 16 (mix p4d/g5). Observed short spikes last month hit ~60 concurrent GPU instances across accounts for ~2h. Network pain: us-west-2a ran out of available IPs during the load test.

Kai Müller: Proposal: request per-AZ GPU quotas to cover 1.5x observed burst + 33% headroom.
- prod per-AZ target: 120 GPUs
- staging per-AZ target: 24 GPUs
- analytics per-AZ target: 48 GPUs
Also request ENI increase to 800 and EIP increase to 300 for the accounts in these regions. These numbers allow rolling upgrades and AZ-failover without immediate throttles.

Alex Henderson: Note on cost: prefer soft limit increases first (no upfront reserved spend). We'll rely on warm-pool autoscaling and canary rollout to avoid steady-state waste. If cloud ops push back, we can provide a staged schedule.

Riya Patel: I'll draft the support requests. Need a 3-month forecast and justification blurb. Draft snippet to use for AWS CLI:

```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase \
  --service-code ec2 \
  --quota-code L-F678F1CE \
  --desired-value 120 \
  --region us-west-2 \
  --profile prod-account
```

(Replace quota-code with GPU family quota where required, and adjust desired-value per account/az.)

infra-bot: Created tickets AWS-3129 (prod us-west-2), AWS-3130 (staging us-west-2), AWS-3131 (analytics us-east-1). Initial review ETA ~48h.

Jordan Li: Also check subnet sizing — for warm pools we should expand to /22 in the warm-subnet to avoid IP exhaustion during bursts. If expansion isn't possible, plan for additional subnets and route table updates.

Alex Henderson: Good. Riya, post the final ticket IDs + cloud responses here. Kai, can you add the per-AZ scaling policy and warm-pool config to the runbook (short PR) so support has the exact deployment steps if they ask? :+1:

Riya Patel: Will do, posting tickets once submitted.

Kai Müller: On it — prepping runbook snippet and will link in the ticket.

Alex Henderson: Thanks — aiming to submit requests by EOD so we have headroom before next canary window.
